accountData.title: Manage my Histae data
accountData.intro: Delete your Histae account or erase selected data while keeping your account. You can also do this on the website without reinstalling the app.
accountData.authIntro: As with “My subscription”, verify your account using its identifier and a code sent by SMS. You do not need to create an account or buy a subscription.
accountData.identityHelp: Your UUID is in your account information in the app. If you no longer have it or cannot receive the SMS, contact us below.
accountData.session: The session expires after 30 minutes. Your SMS code and phone number are not kept in the browser after sign-in.
accountData.partialTitle: Delete data without closing your account
accountData.partialIntro: Choose a category. Your account, other data and subscription are kept. Each deletion requires confirmation.
accountData.photoBody: Remove your photo and its variants. It stops being displayed; the files are then cleaned up in the background. You can add a new photo in the app.
accountData.locationBody: Erase your location and withdraw location consent. Nearby discovery stays unavailable until you grant consent again and update your location in the app.
accountData.sensitiveBody: Erase your declared sex and dating preferences by withdrawing consent for sensitive data. Discovery will be limited until you configure them again in the app.
accountData.deleteBody: Your account is deactivated as soon as the request is accepted. Your phone number, profile, photos, location and associated data are then erased in the background. Messages already exchanged may be anonymised to preserve the other person’s conversation. This action is irreversible.
accountData.subscriptionWarning: Deleting your account does not automatically cancel an Apple or Google subscription. Cancel it with the relevant store. Stripe subscriptions are handled by the erasure workflow.
accountData.retentionBody: Closing your account does not erase records needed for security or rights management: closed rights requests may be kept for 5 years after closure, access logs for 1 year and resolved reports for 3 years after resolution. Technical deletions take place during maintenance runs.
accountData.retentionBilling: Purchase references dissociated from the profile may remain for up to 400 days after the subscription period ends to prevent replay. Payment records remain subject to the relevant provider’s retention periods. Contact us about backups or any specific retention.
accountData.helpBody: You can request account deletion or deletion of selected data by email without using the app. Mention Histae, the phone number associated with the account and the data to delete. We will verify your identity before acting. Never send an SMS code or unsolicited identity documents.
accountData.confirmAccount: You are about to permanently close your Histae account. Access will be disabled and erasure will begin.
accountData.confirmData: You are about to delete the category indicated above. Your other data and account are kept. The consequences described for this category apply.
accountData.successPhoto: Your photo deletion has been accepted. File cleanup continues in the background.
accountData.successLocation: Your location has been deleted and location consent withdrawn. Your account is kept.
accountData.successSensitive: Your sex and dating preferences have been deleted and sensitive-data consent withdrawn. Your account is kept.
accountData.receiptBody: The account is deactivated. Erasure continues in the background; this acknowledgement does not mean all technical cleanup is complete. Keep the reference if you need to contact support.
accountData.unconfirmed: The server response could not be confirmed. Deletion may have been accepted. Contact support before trying again.
accountData.notFound: This data or account is no longer available. Contact support if needed.
